name: xsolla-ai-kit
description: Xsolla agent skills toolkit — guided, end-to-end workflows for merchant setup, catalog design, Login/NewID, payments, webhooks, headless storefronts, and Shop Builder site assembly.

interface.shortDescription: Guided Xsolla workflows from zero to a live game shop
interface.longDescription: Bundles Xsolla workflow skills for headless commerce and Shop Builder. Most skills call Xsolla APIs directly; Shop Builder assembly uses xsolla-cli for authenticated, backed-up, confirmation-gated changes in approved test environments.
